title: MemInfo
description: Parsed /proc/meminfo. Every value is an integer; the kernel's ' kB' suffix is stripped and encoded in the field name instead, so no consumer has to parse units out of a string. Only fields guaranteed across kernel configurations are listed as required; the remainder appear conditionally (hugepages, ZSWAP, CMA), which is why additionalProperties is typed rather than closed.
